RequestCounter.title: RequestCounter
RequestCounter.description: Global atomic sequential counter for Desfrutar WhatsApp availability requests (01, 02, 03...).

lastNumber.description: Last issued sequential request number, incremented atomically by +1 per request.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last atomic increment.

/counters/{counterId}.description: Stores the global sequential counter document at /counters/solicitacoes.
